Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NHAI Young Professional (Legal) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the NHAI Young Professional (Legal) posts is 08 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Young Professional (Legal) post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies for the Young Professional (Legal) position in the National Highways Authority of India.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required qualification for the Young Professional (Legal) role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Degree in Law from a recognized University/National Law School/Institute and have a CLAT (Post Graduate) Score for the year 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to this post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Young Professional (Legal) post is 32 years. Age relaxation is applicable for OBC and PwBD categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional (Legal) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 60,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the NHAI Young Professional (Legal) recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection will be based on merit, specifically on the CLAT (Post Graduate) Score for the year 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for the NHAI Young Professional (Legal) posts?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply only through the online mode for the NHAI Young Professional (Legal) recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for the Young Professional (Legal) position?
faq.answer: The position of Young Professional (Legal) is on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the direct links to the official notification PDF and the online application form in the "Important Links" section of this article.
